recent.text: Two turnovers by Pelle Larsson out of the timeout. Two 3-pointers by Isaiah Collier. And we have a game. Timeout to Erik Spoelstra. Heat up, 101-93, with 6:42 left.
recent.author: Eric Nehm
recent.quoted_text: Collier hits a 3 with a 7:20 left to cut the Heat lead down to 14 points. Erik Spoelstra wants a timeout. And it looks like Giannis Antetokounmpo is coming back into the game.

recent.quoted_text: That's a hard fall for Isaiah Collier. He got the steal on Davion Mitchell and Mitchell tried for the chasedown block, but made contact with Collier in the air. After getting checked on by trainers, Collier got up and went to the line for two free throws.

recent.text: Took a little while, but the Heat opened the lead up a bit during the second shift of the third quarter. Giannis Antetokounmpo doing with his jumper again. Couple mid-rangers and a top of the key 3. He's up to 24pts/9reb/3ast in 23 minutes. Heat up, 89-66, with 2:28 left in Q3.
recent.author: Eric Nehm
recent.quoted_text: Not the most inspired start to the second half by the Heat, but they still lead, 76-64, with 6:20 left in the third quarter. Jaxson Hayes just got hit with a technical on the way to the bench during this timeout though.
